purpose: Validates BIS CPMI d218 harmonised data requirements for a pacs.008 payment instruction: UETR UUIDv4 format, debtor and creditor names, BIC format, LEI format (presence and format; full mod-97 check-digit validation is in lint_lei_payment_binding art-246), and purpose code format. Outputs a CPMI d218 completeness score. Does not validate PostalAddress24 structure (use lint_cbpr_structured_address art-241) or PQC crypto readiness (use check_iso20022_pqc_readiness art-87).
